title: Staging Connector Agent nested source directory exclusion

phases.objective: Repair a failed Staging Docker build by excluding tracked nested n8n-workflows sources without weakening the exact Connector Agent asset image assertion or touching Production.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact-Git-archive Docker build and Connector Agent image asset verifier
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only the manifest-declared Connector files are packaged, nested workflow sources stay excluded, and missing/extra image entries continue to fail closed.
steps: Evaluate .dockerignore against the Connector release manifest and tracked nested source directories.
Run the source-time Connector verifier and release-owner regression tests.
Build the exact Staging Docker image with BuildKit and require the image-mode asset verifier to succeed before deployment.
assertions: Nested n8n-workflows sources remain excluded even when the local-connector parent is unignored.
Every tracked nested Connector directory requires an explicit deny rule.
All manifest-listed files remain packaged, without broader Connector directory inclusion.
The image-stage assertion remains active and fails closed for extra directories or unexpected files.
No credentials, DB migrations, Staging live installation, Production changes, or authority bypass are introduced.
